Strong documentation habits using tools such as Hudu, ticketing platforms such as HaloPSA, and internal communication tools such as Slack. Ability to lead complex troubleshooting efforts and communicate clearly with clients, vendors, peers, and leadership. Experience mentoring junior engineers or acting as a senior escalation point. Ability to participate in on-call, NOC escalation, after-hours maintenance, or incident response as needed. Experience creating technical diagrams, RCA reports, SOPs, escalation playbooks, and operational standards. Key Strengths for Success Strong technical ownership and accountability.
